summary: Reproduced the reported AttributeError in move_logprobs_to_cpu when next_token_token_ids_logprobs_val contains a host list, then made the prefill and decode consumers preserve host-list entries while converting tensor entries. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35052 independently proposes the same consumer-side guard (plus top-logprob fields), but remains open and is not present in the prepared main base. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34075 proposes a decode-producer-only alternative and also remains open.

tests.what_was_measured: On the unmodified recorded base, a mixed host-list/tensor next_token_token_ids_logprobs_val raised AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'tolist' at batch_result_processor.py:539. Raw output: reports/j-e33e1e8cf549/raw/failing_before.txt

Four regression/boundary cases passed: empty host list, tensor-only, mixed empty-list/tensor in move_logprobs_to_cpu, and the duplicated decode normalization path. Raw output: reports/j-e33e1e8cf549/raw/focused_tests_final.txt

On AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), a real device tensor mixed with a host-list entry converted to the same values as an independent CPU/NumPy reference. Raw output: reports/j-e33e1e8cf549/raw/gpu_conversion.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-e33e1e8cf549/raw/gpu_conversion.txt records AMD Instinct MI355X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and equality with the CPU/NumPy reference.

remaining_limitations: No model weights or original request/server configuration were supplied, so no full serving/model reproduction was claimed. The deterministic fixture was unnecessary because the defect is isolated before model semantics in a scheduler conversion method. No multi-node or distributed workload was tested. The related MLX selection command collected no executed tests (26 deselected) and is retained only as raw diagnostic output, not validation. Top-logprob fields have a similar open upstream proposal but were not changed because issue 35705 specifically reports next_token_token_ids_logprobs_val. No native code was changed or rebuilt.
